svg.title: Transaction log recovery: TxnLogEntry with TxnHeader, Record and TxnDigest
svg.desc: The article's original screenshot of parsed log output could not be recovered; this is the author's own diagram of the transaction log format and how it is replayed from the same series of notes, with labels translated to English.

div.div:
log_zxid = largest zxid restored from the snapshot + 1. Sort the log.x files by suffix, descending, and take those with a suffix above log_zxid plus the first one below it: a suffix is only the first zxid in its file, so that file can hold later zxids.
This gives List<File> restoreFiles

div.div:
Compare each parsed TxnLogEntry's zxid with log_zxid; while zxid < log_zxid, skip it.
Then, based on the TxnLogEntry type, run
processTransaction
